settings.question: What are the hours at Prince Tires 42 Ave SW?
settings.answer: Prince Tires 42 Ave SW is open seven days a week: [[hours_sw]]. We close over the Friday midday break. Holiday hours can differ, so call [[phone_sw]] on a holiday.

settings.question: Where is the Prince Tires SW Calgary shop?
settings.answer: At [[address_sw]], in Manchester, just off Macleod Trail and about five minutes south of downtown.

settings.question: Can I walk in, or do I need an appointment?
settings.answer: Walk-ins are welcome and are fitted around booked work. To skip the wait, request a time online or call [[phone_sw]]. An online booking is a request until we confirm the time with you. In the late-October to mid-November changeover rush, booking ahead is the safer bet.

settings.question: How much is a winter tire changeover at the SW shop?
settings.answer: Swapping a set that's already on rims is $15 a tire ($60 for four) on a car, SUV, EV or van, and $20 a tire on a truck. Mounting loose tires you bring in onto rims starts at $30 a tire and includes a standard balance. Prices are before GST, and the booking page shows your price before you send the request.

settings.question: Can I get road force balancing at 42 Ave SW?
settings.answer: No. Road force balancing is done only at our Edmonton Trail NE shop: $35 a wheel or $140 for four. A standard $20 wheel balance is available here at 42 Ave SW.

settings.question: Do you have tires in stock at 42 Ave SW?
settings.answer: 42 Ave SW is our main shop and carries our larger inventory of passenger, light-truck, winter and trailer tires. Stock changes every day, so check your size online or call [[phone_sw]] before you come. When you order online and your tires are in stock here, you can choose pickup at 42 Ave SW at checkout.

settings.question: Do you do wheel alignments or store tires?
settings.answer: No. We don't do wheel alignments, and we don't offer tire storage — your off-season set goes home with you. We do balancing, rotation, repairs, TPMS and installation.
